title: Tuk Tuk Auto Song | Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes, Traffic Light Safety | BuBu TV - English
description:
Hop in the tuk tuk auto and go for a happy ride around town with the kids and Amma!
This fun rhyme teaches little ones to hold on tight and wait patiently at the red light.
Sing along, wave hello, and enjoy a safe trip home together!

Tuk tuk tuk, the auto's here
Little sis hops in, yellow top shines bright
Beep beep beep, Amma climbs in too
Let's go zoom off for a ride!
Tuk tuk auto, hold on tight
Zoom zoom, let's go round the town
Beep beep, beep beep
Tuk tuk auto, hooray!
Stop, stop, stop, the signal's gone red
The auto slowly comes to a halt
Stop stop, stop stop
Let's wait a while, wait a while!
Tuk tuk auto, hold on tight
Zoom zoom, let's go round the town
Beep beep, beep beep
Tuk tuk auto, hooray!
Big brother counts, "red, red, red"
The kids sit still and wait
Red stop, green go, red stop, green go
Soon the light turns green!
Tuk tuk auto, hold on tight
Zoom zoom, let's go round the town
Beep beep, beep beep
Tuk tuk auto, hooray!
Green light, go, tuk tuk, tuk tuk
Home we reach, safe and sound
Amma waves, the gate swings open
Tuk tuk, we're home!
